summary: Frontend-only mandatory menu-routing retest completed on public preview. Menu pointer-click routing is still non-deterministic and fails required fresh matrix; keyboard activation passes. Timeline lock/arrow behavior passes once timeline is successfully entered.

ui_bugs.issue: Fresh page matrix failed for all required links (Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories); each click remained at active-node-0 (ORIGIN).
Quick open then immediate Timeline click still lands at ORIGIN (active-node-0).
Sequential run is still inconsistent: Legacy and Victories fail while Timeline/Cars/Tracks pass.

integration_issues.issue: Timeline via menu is non-deterministic (first click failed, second retry passed). Once landed on TIMELINE, wheel lock and arrow controls worked correctly.

action_items: Make menu pointer-click routing deterministic for all required links in fresh sessions.
Eliminate first-click menu no-op path (especially quick open -> immediate click).
Ensure fallback pending route is consumed when set after initial mount, not only during first useLayoutEffect run.
Re-run mandatory matrix: fresh-per-link, sequential, quick click, keyboard activation, timeline-through-menu lock behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Current fallback writes window.__pendingSpatialRoute when window.__spatialGo is unavailable, but SpatialExperience consumes pending route only once in mount-time useLayoutEffect; pending values set later can be stranded.
Observed behavior (fresh failures + retry success) indicates router-readiness/lifecycle timing race remains for pointer flow.
Keyboard path (onClick detail===0) is currently more reliable than pointer flow, suggesting event-path asymmetry between onPointerDown and routing readiness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PASS: Keyboard activation works (Enter on Cars -> active-node-3, Space on Tracks -> active-node-7). PASS: After menu timeline retry lands, wheel lock holds node active-node-2 on small wheel; ArrowRight and next button increment year (2007->2008->2009). PASS: Gallery buttons move strip (0->1155->0), quote next changes text, victories filter 2020 updates count (105->11), no '.error' selectors, no horizontal overflow. FAIL: Fresh matrix all five pointer clicks stayed ORIGIN; quick open immediate click stayed ORIGIN; sequential matrix still inconsistent (Legacy/Victories failed).
rca of the issue: Repro: load page, open menu, click required link quickly/fresh -> viewport remains active-node-0. In same broader session, retry or later clicks can succeed. Likely cause is unresolved timing gap between pointer routing and spatial router readiness: Nav sets __pendingSpatialRoute when __spatialGo is missing, but SpatialExperience only consumes pending during initial mount, so late pending assignments are not guaranteed to execute.
